A synergistic blend of 7 high-potency plant oils: Batana, Rosemary, Black Castor, Jojoba, Argan, Sweet Almond, and Peppermint. Delivers a cooling, invigorating scalp sensation while sealing moisture into fragile lengths.

Key Benefits

haircare_products.title: Zavelyn Batana Deep Conditioning Hair Mask (120g)
haircare_products.body_html:
Give Dry, Rough Hair the Deep Conditioning It Deserves.

Formulated as an intensive weekly conditioning treatment, Zavelyn Batana Deep Conditioning Hair Mask envelopes parched, textured, and heat-stressed strands in a rich botanical moisture veil. Powered by traditional Honduran Batana oil and fortified with cold-pressed coconut oil, ginger root lipid extracts, camellia seed oil, castor oil, and bio-active biotin, this restorative butter-cream treatment softens coarse cuticles, detangles unruly textures, and restores touchable bounce without greasy weight or silicone buildup.

Why Your Strands Will Love It

  • Intensive Moisture Infusion: Replenishes depleted lipid moisture in coarse, porous, and chemical-processed strands.
  • Silky Slip & Effortless Detangling: Melts through stubborn knots and unruly curl patterns, dramatically minimizing mechanical comb breakage.
  • Cuticle Smoothing & Frizz Control: Seals rough hair shafts to tame humidity-induced flyaways and split-end brittleness.
  • Touchable Softness & Natural Luster: Camellia and coconut lipids impart vibrant, healthy shine and flexible bounce.
  • Clean Rinse-Out Formulation: Rinses thoroughly clean with lukewarm water, leaving strands soft, airy, and refreshed.

Who It's For

Ideal for coarse, wavy, curly, coily (2A–4C), color-treated, bleached, or excessively dry hair textures that require deep structural moisture rather than daily surface conditioning.

Texture & Sensory Ritual

A decadent, dense whipped butter-cream with a rich golden-cream hue. Spreads effortlessly from mid-lengths to ends and delights the senses with an uplifting, warm aroma of subtle ginger root and toasted tropical coconut.

How to Use

  1. Cleanse: Wash hair thoroughly with your favorite sulfate-free shampoo and gently squeeze out excess water.
  2. Apply: Scoop a generous palm-sized amount (adjust for strand length and density). Work evenly through damp lengths and ends, combing through with fingers or a wide-tooth comb for complete distribution.
  3. Process: Leave on for 5 to 10 minutes for express conditioning, or 15 to 20 minutes with a warm towel or shower cap for an intensive moisture bath.
  4. Rinse: Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water until water runs completely clear. Style as desired. Use 1–2 times weekly.

The Zavelyn Batana Routine Pairing

For the ultimate restorative hair ritual, pair with Zavelyn BotanaRoots Pure Batana Scalp & Hair Oil. Apply 3–5 drops of Batana Oil directly to scalp parted sections 30 minutes before shampooing as a pre-wash treatment, then follow cleansing with this Deep Conditioning Hair Mask to seal lengths and ends.

Formulation & Ingredients

Full INCI List: Aqua (Deionized Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Steartrimonium Chloride, Elaeis Oleifera (Batana) Kernel Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Camellia Japonica Seed Oil, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Extract, Biotin, Glycerin, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Dimethiconol, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Aroma (Natural Fragrance).

Formulated without sulfates, parabens, phthalates, synthetic dye additives, or mineral oil dilution.

Safety & Patch Test Guidance

For external cosmetic use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse immediately with clean water. We recommend performing a 24-hour patch test on a small area of skin (inner arm) prior to initial use. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.

Product Details

  • Net Weight: 120g / 4.23 oz.
  • Packaging: Recyclable wide-mouth PET jar with protective tamper-evident inner seal and matte black twist cap, packed in outer protective carton.
  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep jar tightly sealed between uses.

haircare_products.title: Zavelyn BotanaRoots Pure Batana Scalp & Hair Oil (60ml)
haircare_products.body_html:
Pure Cold-Pressed Batana Scalp & Strand Revitalizer

Nourish your scalp and strengthen hair strands with 100% unrefined cold-pressed Batana oil. Packed with essential oleic and linoleic fatty acids, phytosterols, and natural carotenoids to moisturize dry scalps and protect brittle hair against daily breakage.

Key Benefits

  • Deep Scalp Nourishment: Restores moisture to dry, compromised scalps without clogging pores.
  • Strand Fortification: Smooths cuticles to significantly decrease breakage and shedding.
  • 100% Clean Botanical: Free from parabens, sulfates, silicones, and artificial fragrances.

How To Use

Warm 3–5 drops between palms and gently massage into scalp and hairline. Leave on for at least 30 minutes or overnight before washing, or apply a drop to dry ends daily for shine and heat protection.

haircare_products.title: Zavelyn Botanical Curl Defining & Frizz-Shield Cream (100ml)
haircare_products.body_html:
Soft-Touch Curl Definition & 72-Hour Frizz Shield

Formulated with Moroccan argan oil, plant keratin, and raw shea butter to define 2A to 4C curl patterns. Imparts soft touchable bounce without crunchiness, flaking, or heavy residue.

Key Benefits

  • Bouncy Definition: Shapes and accentuates natural waves, curls, and coils.
  • Humidity Resistance: Blocks moisture-induced frizz while preserving softness.
  • Zero Crunch: Flexible lightweight hold keeps hair touchable and radiant.

How To Use

Section damp hair and rake a quarter-sized amount from mid-lengths to ends. Scrunch upward toward scalp to encourage curl formation, then air dry or diffuse.

haircare_products.title: Zavelyn Instant Hair Density Keratin Building Fibers (100g)
haircare_products.body_html:
Instant Cosmetic Hair Density in Seconds

Transform sparse spots, wide parting lines, and thinning crowns with electrostatic keratin building fibers. Undetectable micro-fibers bond securely to existing strands for all-day wind, sweat, and moisture-resistant cosmetic fullness.

Key Benefits

  • Instant Fullness: Conveys natural hair density in under 30 seconds.
  • Natural Keratin Match: Blends seamlessly with existing hair textures and tones.
  • Mess-Free Application: Electrostatic cling locks fibers to hair shafts until your next shampoo.

How To Use

Dry and style hair completely. Gently shake or sprinkle fibers over thinning areas until scalp is fully covered. Pat lightly with fingertips to disperse, and set with light hairspray if desired.

haircare_products.title: Zavelyn Precision Hairline Shadow & Root Concealer Compact (4g)
haircare_products.body_html:
Seamless Hairline Shading & Temple Touch-Up

Touch up uneven hairlines, cover gray roots, and frame sparse temples with high-adhesion squalane-infused mineral powder. Includes integrated precision puff sponge and mirror for on-the-go definition.

Key Benefits

  • Precision Framing: Soft-blend pigment sculpts hairline naturally.
  • Sweat & Transfer Resistant: Long-wear mineral formula resists fading throughout active days.
  • Travel-Ready Compact: Built-in mirror and applicator puff for effortless touch-ups.

How To Use

Dab the built-in sponge puff onto the compact, then gently press along the hairline, crown, or gray root areas until desired coverage is achieved.

haircare_products.title: Zavelyn Raw Unrefined Batana Scalp & Cuticle Balm (20g)
haircare_products.body_html:
Solid-to-Oil Melting Scalp & Strand Butter

Hand-crafted raw Batana butter blended with rich shea and botanical oils. Melts effortlessly into skin and hair upon contact to soothe itchy, dry scalps and seal fragile split ends.

Key Benefits

  • Intensive Moisture Seal: Locks in hydration for deeply parched hair cuticles.
  • Scalp Comfort: Calms flaky, irritated scalp patches with natural emollient lipids.
  • Compact Travel Tin: Mess-free solid formula perfect for daily styling and travel.

How To Use

Scoop a pea-sized amount and melt between fingertips. Smooth onto dry ends, edges, or massage directly into dry scalp areas before bedtime.

We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

To start a return, you can contact us at support@tryzavelyn.com. Please note that returns will need to be sent to the following address: [INSERT RETURN ADDRESS]

If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

You can always contact us for any return question at support@tryzavelyn.com.


Damages and issues
Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged or if you receive the wrong item, so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.


Exceptions / non-returnable items
Certain types of items cannot be returned, like perishable goods (such as food, flowers, or plants), custom products (such as special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (such as beauty products). We also do not accept returns for hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please get in touch if you have questions or concerns about your specific item.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.


Exchanges
The fastest way to ensure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.


European Union 14 day cooling off period
Notwithstanding the above, if the merchandise is being shipped into the European Union, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason and without a justification. As above, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.


Refunds
We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved or not. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method within 10 business days. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund too.
If more than 15 business days have passed since we’ve approved your return, please contact us at support@tryzavelyn.com.

Shipping Policy

Last Updated: October 10, 2026

At Zavelyn, we are committed to providing a smooth and reliable shopping experience. Please review our shipping policy below for information about order processing, delivery times, and shipment tracking.

1. Order Processing Time

All orders are processed within 2 business days after the order is placed.

Orders are not processed or shipped on weekends or public holidays. During periods of high order volume, processing may take slightly longer. If there is a significant delay with your order, we will notify you by email.

2. Shipping & Delivery Times

Our estimated shipping time is 7–15 business days after your order has been processed and shipped.

Please note that delivery times are estimates and may vary depending on your location, shipping carrier, customs procedures, and other factors beyond our control.

3. Shipping Confirmation & Tracking

Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking information, when available.

Please allow some time for tracking information to become active after the shipping confirmation has been sent.

4. Shipping Delays

While we do our best to ensure timely delivery, Zavelyn is not responsible for delays caused by shipping carriers, customs clearance, severe weather, public holidays, or other circumstances beyond our control.

If your order has not arrived within the estimated delivery window, please contact our support team for assistance.

5. Incorrect Shipping Information

Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete shipping information at checkout.

If you notice an error in your shipping address, please contact us as soon as possible at support@tryzavelyn.com. We cannot guarantee that changes can be made once an order has been processed or shipped.

6. Lost or Missing Packages

If your tracking information indicates that your package has been delivered but you have not received it, please check around your delivery location and with household members or neighbors.

If you still cannot locate your package, contact us at support@tryzavelyn.com, and we will help you investigate the issue.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our shipping policy or need assistance with your order, please contact us:

Brand: Zavelyn
Email: support@tryzavelyn.com

We appreciate your trust in Zavelyn and thank you for shopping with us.
